system.description:
Turns away unwanted magic. Wards have a Ward Rating that reduces sorcerous Damage and Influence, and a Ward Penalty to all casting they affect (p. 104).

Ward ratings (rating / penalty): Incidental 1/–1 · Apprentice 2/–1 · Basic 3/–2 · Standard 4/–3 · Adept 5/–1D · Potent 6/–1D · Powerful 7/–2D · Master 8/–2D · Arch-Ward 9/–3D.

Sword Chronicle p. 103. A Sorcerous Benefit (Blood of the Sorcerers, Blood of the Far Isles, Natural Sorcerer or Sorcerous Initiation) grants access.
system.tools: Salts and powders, mirrors and lead seals, protective oils, chalk, chisels and inks for sigils.
system.initiation: Each degree on a folk-ward lasts ten minutes instead of one, and you may work folk-wards for others at Formidable (12).
system.resonances: Protective salts, oils and inscribed sigils.
